question: In November 2020, India and _________ jointly launched Phase 2 of the Rupay card.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bhutan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Prime Ministers of India and Bhutan have virtually launched RuPay Card phase-2 in Bhutan on November 20, 2020.**
 
• The two PMs launched** phase 1** of the project during PM Modi's visit to Bhutan in **August 2019.**
 
• The implementation of **phase 1 of the RuPay card enables Indian visitors to Bhutan to access ATMs **and point of sale terminals in Bhutan.
 
• The** phase-2** will allow **Bhutanese cardholders to access the RuPay network in India.**
